record.context_brief: Weak closedness of Chebyshev sets in smooth uniformly convex spaces
record.original_question: In a smooth uniformly convex Banach space, is every Chebyshev set weakly closed?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a real Banach space. Recall that $X$ is called smooth if at every nonzero point $x \in X$ the norm has a unique supporting functional, i.e. there is a unique $f \in X^*$ with $\|f\|=1$ and $f(x)=\|x\|$. The space $X$ is called uniformly convex if for every $\varepsilon \in (0,2]$ there exists $\delta>0$ such that for all $x,y \in X$ with $\|x\|=\|y\|=1$ and $\|x-y\|\geq \varepsilon$ one has $\|(x+y)/2\| \le 1-\delta$.

A nonempty subset $C \subseteq X$ is called a Chebyshev set if for every $x \in X$ there exists exactly one point $P_C(x) \in C$ satisfying $\|x - P_C(x)\| = \inf_{y \in C}\|x-y\|$.

A subset $C \subseteq X$ is weakly closed if it is closed with respect to the weak topology $\sigma(X,X^*)$.

Question: If $X$ is a smooth uniformly convex Banach space, must every Chebyshev set $C \subseteq X$ be weakly closed?
artifact.status_search_result: The convexity problem for Chebyshev sets in smooth uniformly convex Banach spaces (and even in Hilbert space) remains a well-known open problem. It is known that this problem is equivalent to asking whether every Chebyshev set in such a space is weakly closed; while weakly closed Chebyshev sets in smooth uniformly convex spaces are known to be convex, the question of whether every Chebyshev set is weakly closed has not been resolved.

status_evidence.title: Proximality and Chebyshev sets
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses the still-open Chebyshev set convexity problem and equivalent formulations including weak closedness.
status_evidence.claim: The Chebyshev convexity problem in smooth uniformly convex (and Hilbert) spaces is still open, equivalent to weak closedness.

status_evidence.title: A look at proximinal and Chebyshev sets in Banach spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Survey noting that weakly closed Chebyshev sets in smooth uniformly convex Banach spaces are convex, but convexity of arbitrary Chebyshev sets remains open.
status_evidence.claim: Weak closedness of Chebyshev sets in smooth uniformly convex Banach spaces is not known.
